# E0215: a minor version narrows the values a field accepts

A minor version accepts every value its predecessor accepts at every path. A
bound, a narrower kind or a smaller disjunction rejects values the predecessor
accepted. A field the predecessor admitted only through `...` is the same case
(see also issue #47): it may already hold any value, so declaring it with a type
narrows it.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				n: int
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				n: int & >=0
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0215]: n in schema 0.1 is now uint, which does not accept every value of the prior int
  --> lineage.cue:11:5
   |
11 |                 n: int & >=0
   |                 ^
   |
   = note: schema 0.1 is declared as a minor version of 0.0, so every instance of schema 0.0 must be an instance of it (compatibility rule value-narrowed)
   = help: make the change compatible, or make this version 1.0
```
